scope: Offline synthetic Node24 reference; best-supported among generated admissible candidates, never universal physiological optimality
questions: What primary/secondary goal and horizon are supplied?
What phase/block is supplied, unknown or inferred as request intent?
What comparable exposure and actual response are known?
Which envelopes and concrete options are admissible under current approval?
Which valid option best serves this goal and phase?
What smallest sufficient change addresses the material observation?
What uncertainty remains without invented facts?
What observation will retain, progress, regress or refute this choice?

ordering.score: No universal weighted sum. Candidate validity precedes ordinal preference; deterministic ID tie-break conveys no physiological superiority.

candidateAudit: why valid alternative is suboptimal in this context
qualityAuthority: Runtime quality field is provisional author self-assessment. Independent quality review is required before claiming quality success; expected outputs are not runtime imports.
